unclassified.source_text: The requirement for the degree is 128 units.
unclassified.why: A total degree unit count with no filter or pool; not a course-selection, distribution, reuse, or sequencing rule.

unclassified.source_text: A grade of C (2.0) or better is required for each of the core courses CSCI 102L , CSCI 103 , CSCI 170 , CSCI 104 and CSCI 201 .
unclassified.why: Minimum grade requirement, which is out of scope per taxonomy.

unclassified.source_text: Courses with a grade of C- or below must be repeated; courses may only be retaken once.
unclassified.why: Minimum grades and retake policy is explicitly out of scope.

unclassified.source_text: Students who do not satisfy the degree requirement after repeating a class will be disqualified from the program.
unclassified.why: Describes a consequence of failing to meet requirements, not a course-plan constraint.

unclassified.source_text: A cumulative grade point average of C (2.0) is required for all courses taken at USC as well as all upper-division courses applied toward the major, regardless of the department in which the courses are taken.
unclassified.why: GPA floor requirement, out of scope.

unclassified.source_text: WRIT 340 Advanced Writing (Communication for Engineers) is strongly recommended for CSGM majors.
unclassified.why: Advisory recommendation, not a binding requirement.
